governingBehavior: Service behaves as a short human exchange: attention, an expressed need, a specific response, useful next action and a clear path back.
compositionGrammar: One service turn owns the visual field at a time; do not tile competing cards.
Typography creates spatial hierarchy before decoration does.
Answers enter as consequences of the user's intent; product imagery is not wallpaper.
A thin attention signal may cross the field, but chat bubbles, speech balloons and assistant avatars are forbidden.
Utility information stays inside the same call-and-response rhythm rather than switching to a generic footer/dashboard language.
imageGrammar: Real Du Bonheur product and shop images are source/capture dependent.
Until real sources are present, material studies must be visibly marked non-documentary proxies.
A product image appears only after intent narrows enough to make it an answer.
Avoid floating isolated pastry objects and luxury still-life staging.

colorGrammar.attention: acid citron used only for attention, selection or service completion
colorGrammar.rule: Color supports service state; it is not the identity by itself.

motionStoryboard: ATTENTION — prompt holds; only the attention signal changes.
CHOICE — selected language becomes spatially dominant while unused choices recede without disappearing theatrically.
RESPONSE — product or place evidence enters as the consequence of the choice.
PREPARATION — information reorganizes rather than opening a modal layer.
HANDOFF — the final useful action settles inside the thumb/reading zone.
RETURN — the previous question remains recoverable without browser-back dependence.
mobileRule: Mobile is the native direct-service form: one prompt, one meaningful response set, one answer and one obvious next action. Desktop gains scale and whitespace, not extra conceptual layers.
antiPatterns: AI assistant avatar or sparkle language
fashion-editorial typography that makes utility information secondary
decorative motion unrelated to attention, response, preparation or handoff
